description: An equivalence of index sets and equal cardinalities at corresponding fibers preserve the size of a tagged union.
signature:
Cardinal.mk_sigma_congr.{u, v} {ι ι' : Type u} {f : ι → Type v} {g : ι' → Type v} (e : ι ≃ ι')
  (h : ∀ (i : ι), Cardinal.mk (f i) = Cardinal.mk (g (e i))) :
  Cardinal.mk ((i : ι) × f i) = Cardinal.mk ((i : ι') × g i)
